title: Bridge inspection workflow
scopeNote: Workflow guidance for this learning portal. It does not replace an approved inspection plan or signed engineering assessment.

types.name: Casual Inspection
types.activities: Patrol-based visual checking without specialist equipment.

types.name: Routine Inspection
types.purpose: Check the general condition of the structure.
types.activities: Close-up visual inspection of bridge condition.

types.name: Regular Inspection
types.purpose: Identify damage and defects for maintenance planning.

types.name: Principal Inspection
types.purpose: Complete a detailed structural safety evaluation.
types.activities: Detailed investigation and structural safety assessment.

types.name: Emergency Inspection
types.purpose: Check safety immediately after a damaging event.
types.activities: Immediate inspection after a flood, collision, collapse or other damaging event.

captureSteps: Select the approved structure record and inspection type.
Review the inspection plan, member hierarchy and previous observations.
Record the affected member, damage type, measured quantity and location.
Attach photographs or drawings only through the governed inspection system.
Review condition grades, repair needs and completeness before submission.
Apply approved results to the maintenance history after technical review.
